## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix the missing-results release bypass before merge: an absent results file now authorizes a release.

## Changes
The pull request adds a missing-file fallback for saved results and optional display preferences with a light-theme default. Added tests cover saved pass/fail results and both preference-loading paths; this review read these tests without running them.

## Critical
- app/results.py:8 — correctness — Prevent missing results from authorizing a release — When the results file does not exist, `release_allowed(path)` now returns `True`: your new fallback returns `[]`, and `all()` accepts the empty sequence. Previously, the missing file raised `FileNotFoundError`. — The release gate can authorize a release without evidence that any checks passed. — Fix: Preserve the exception or explicitly reject missing results, and extend `test_saved_checks_control_release`.
